card.name: The word risk before 'factors'
card.fires_on: The word 'risk' (or 'RISK') when it is used as a modifier right after words like with, additional, history of, or and, usually leading into 'factors' for a disease.

modes.label: Risk as modifier
modes.description: 'risk' follows a patient-group phrase and precedes 'factors' for a named condition.
modes.example: particularly those with<< risk>> factors for skin cancer. 5.

modes.label: Capitalised split word
modes.description: The upper-case 'ISK' ends a split 'RISK' in an all-caps warning heading, before FACTORS.
modes.example: ULTRA-RAPID METABOLISM OF CODEINE AND OTHER R<<ISK>> FACTORS FOR LIFE-THREATEN

card.writes: It suppresses further forms of the word risk, so the model avoids repeating 'risk' right after it.
card.plain: It marks the word 'risk' in phrases like 'patients with risk factors for' a disease.
